title: Lanterns and Lesser Fires
summary: Light and warmth for the dark months. — E. Pryce

pages.text: Hold the wet linen a hand above a low flame and {~draw the damp out along the thread~}. It dries {~without scorching~}.
Cup the hands {~around nothing~} and breathe three times. The warmth {~stays till the errand is done~}.
A spark {~from a dry word~}, for damp kindling. {~Keep the word short.~}
Gather the heat {~between the palms~} until it will not be held, {~then throw~}. Whatever it {~meets~} burns {~to the ground~}.
pages.authorNote: Outlier, between a linen charm and warm hands. Wren's goal and her accident.
